standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings, I am trying to rejuvenate the forests with a ritual. Would you like to help?

steps.npc: Oh, well, if you change your mind, just ask.
If you could help block the odd ritual circles by standing on them, I will be able to power up the ritual.

standard-dialogue-completing-the-event.text: If the player completes at least one step of the ritual:

steps.text: If the player only receives anima bark:
Well done, you completed [1-8] step[s] of the ritual! The Dryad has left you a gift...
a number of anima bark correlating to the number of correct steps
If the player also receives a Petal garland:
The Dryad also hands you a Petal garland.

overhead-dialogue.text: If 0% progress was made during the event:
If 1-24% progress was made during the event:

steps.npc: Under one-quarter of the ritual steps have been completed.

overhead-dialogue.text: If 25-49% progress was made during the event:

steps.npc: Over one-quarter of the ritual steps have been completed.

overhead-dialogue.text: If 50-74% progress was made during the event:

steps.npc: Over half the ritual steps have been completed.

overhead-dialogue.text: If 75-99% progress was made during the event:

steps.npc: Over three-quarters of the ritual steps were completed. Well done!

overhead-dialogue.text: If 100% progress was made during the event:

steps.npc: You all completed every ritual step, amazing!
